{{Quote|Fighters incoming. Gold Two and Five on me for the trench. The rest of the squad, engage the TIEs. Hold them off.|Jon Vander gives orders to Torsyn and the rest of Gold Squadron|<ref name="Sparks">{{StoryCite|story=Sparks (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>}}
'''Ryle Torsyn''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. While in the [[Dantooine base|rebel base]] on the [[planet]] [[Dantooine]], he discovered an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Homing beacon|tracking device]] in a delivery of equipment, which led to the base being evacuated.

During the [[Battle of Yavin]], Torsyn was stationed in the Alliance's new base in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. When the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] entered the [[Yavin system]] to destroy the base, Torsyn [[pilot]]ed a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]] as part of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]]. Torsyn was [[Death|killed]] along with all but one [[Evaan Verlaine|member]] of his [[squadron]], but the Alliance managed to destroy the [[Death Star]].

==Biography==
===Evacuating Dantooine===
The [[human]]<ref name="ANH" /> Ryle Torsyn joined the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="RebelPilots" /> as a volunteer [[Rebel pilot|pilot]]<ref name="OtFL">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' establishes that all [[Rebel pilot|pilots]] of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] were volunteers.</ref> while the Alliance was based<ref name="RebelPilots" /> in its [[Dantooine base|first headquarters]] on the [[planet]] [[Dantooine]]. during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="BMF37">{{BuildFalconCite|37|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> He<ref name="RebelPilots" /> spent [[time]] at the Dantooine base, which was intended to be temporary, but its use continued and security grew lax until Torsyn eventually discovered an Imperial [[Homing beacon|tracking device]] hidden in a delivery of equipment. The device was destroyed and the base was immediately evacuated, although unbeknownst to the rebels, the device had actually failed and the Empire remained unaware of the Dantooine base.<ref name="BMF37">{{BuildFalconCite|37|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref>

[[File:TorsinHelmet-ANH.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Ryle Torsyn donning a white flight helmet with a blue rebel starbird symbol in the cockpit of a Y-wing starfighter in the Great Temple on Yavin 4.|Ryle Torsyn flew a Y-wing at the Battle of Yavin.]]
The Alliance soon created a new headquarters in the [[Great Temple]]<ref name="BMF37" /> on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> where Torsyn and his colleagues were transferred.<ref name="RebelPilots" /> During the [[Battle of Yavin]], the Empire learned of the new base's location and the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] was sent to the [[Yavin system]] to destroy it. Having [[Death Star plans|learned]] of a [[Thermal exhaust port|vulnerability]] in the weapon's design, the Alliance mounted an attack on it.<ref name="ANH" />

===Battle of Yavin===
Torsyn was selected to fly one<ref name="ANH" /> of the eight [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s that made up [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]]<ref name="RebelPilots" /> under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander]].<ref name="DutchDB">{{Databank|jon-dutch-vander|Jon "Dutch" Vander}}</ref> The [[pilot]] climbed into his [[Starship|vehicle]] in the hangar of the Great Temple before being handed his [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] by a member of the [[Rebel technician|ground crew]].<ref name="ANH" /> After the initial attack on the [[Death Star]] began, Vander broke the [[squadron]], taking [[Dex Tiree]] and [[Davish Krail]] to make a [[Meridian trench|trench]] run while Torsin and the other four pilots in the squadron split off and held back.<ref name="Grounded">{{StoryCite|story=Grounded|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>

[[File:Battle_of_Yavin.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=A group of rebel X-wing and Y-wing starfighters in space preparing to attack the Death Star with Yavin 4 and Yavin Prime visible in the background.|Ryle Torsyn was one of many pilots who perished at Yavin.]]
After [[Gazdo Woolcob]] became the first member of the squadron to be shot down,<ref name="Grounded" /> Vander ordered Torsyn and the three other survivors to engage the Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] and hold them off while he, Tiree, and Krail entered the trench;<ref name="Sparks" /> however, Gold Leader and his wingmen were then all [[Death|killed]] during the run.<ref name="ANH" /> Torsyn was then shot down by enemy fire, perishing<ref name="RebelPilots" /> along with two of the other Gold Squadron pilots before [[Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis]] began a second run down the trench.<ref name="French">''[[A New Hope - The Film Novel]]''</ref> The second trench run also failed, but the third succeeded when Red Squadron [[Luke Skywalker]] destroyed the Death Star. This left [[Lieutenant]] [[Evaan Verlaine]] as the only surviving member of Gold Squadron.<ref name="Grounded" />

==Personality and traits==
Torsyn had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, and light skin.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
Ryle Torsyn wore an orange [[flight suit]] with a white [[flak vest]] and a K-22995 light [[flight helmet]] marked with two blue [[Rebel Alliance starbird]]s. He had two [[Code cylinder|data cylinders]] on his left sleeve and wore a pair of black [[Flight glove|flight gauntlets]] while piloting a BTL-A4 Y-wing assault [[starfighter]]/[[bomber]] during the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BTMF37.png|thumb|right|250px|alt=The cover for issue 37 of Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon.|Ryle Torsyn was first identified in canon in the ''Build the Millennium Falcon'' magazine.]]
Ryle Torsyn first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The scenes in the Great Temple hangar were filmed on H Stage at [[Shepperton Studios]] in [[Wikipedia:London|London]] between [[June 9]] and [[June 14|14]], [[1976]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars]]''</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in "Visting Dantooine," an article in the "[[Guide to the Galaxy]]" department of the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 37|thirty-seventh issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine,<ref name="BMF37" /> which was written by [[Tim Veekhoven]]<ref name="SM">Social media correspondence with [[Tim Veekhoven]] {{C|[[:File:TimVeekhoven-Credits.png|screenshot]]}}</ref> and published around [[September 16]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BMFdates|37}}</ref> ''Build the Millennium Falcon'' used the spelling "Ryle Torsin" for the character's name,<ref name="BMF37" /> but ''[[Pilots of the Rebel Alliance]]'', part of De Agostini's [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] line<ref name="RebelPilots" /> released on [[March 4]], [[2022]],<ref name="Altaya">{{Altaya|lang=fr|url=livres-bd/encyclopedie-star-wars|text=Official Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref> used the spelling "Ryle Torsyn." This article assumes the more recent source to be correct.<ref name="RebelPilots" />

The character was previously identified in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, using the spelling "[[Ryle Torsyn/Legends|Ryle Torsyn]]," which was first used on two cards in the [[1998]] "[[Special Edition Limited]]" expansion to the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''. In Legends, Torsyn used the [[Callsign/Legends|callsign]] [[Gold Three/Legends|Gold Three]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]];<ref name="CCGRyleTorysyn">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Ryle Torsyn}}</ref><ref name="CCGGold3">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Gold 3}}</ref> however, in canon, the [[callsign]] is instead used by Evaan Verlaine.<ref name="USWNE" />
